name: Gnomeregan Gumdrop
summary: A Gnomeregan Gumdrop is a specialty seasonal sweet distributed during Hallow's End on behalf of the displaced gnomes. Adventurers fetch this confection to help the sick child Jesper in Stormwind's orphanage celebrate the holiday.

sections.title: A Taste of Gnomish Ingenuity
sections.body: While innkeepers across the Alliance dispense regional treats during Hallow's End, the exiled gnomes of Gnomeregan do not have a full capital inn of their own to operate. Instead, the inventive gnome Talvash del Kissel, residing in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, hands out Gnomeregan Gumdrops to travelers willing to play along with his festive tricks. Despite the radioactive disaster that drove his people from their subterranean kingdom, gnomes still proudly share their distinct confectionery with the wider Alliance.

sections.title: A Treat for Jesper
sections.body: Because Jesper is sick and confined to the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square, he cannot travel the continents to go trick-or-treating himself. A Gnomeregan Gumdrop is one of the four essential regional confections—alongside treats from Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus—that kind-hearted travelers gather across the Alliance capitals to bring the festivities to him.

faq.q: Where does a Gnomeregan Gumdrop come from?
faq.answer: It is provided by Talvash del Kissel, a gnome tinker located in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, when you perform a trick for him during the Hallow's End festival.

faq.q: Why isn't this candy handed out in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Gnomeregan was overrun by troggs and irradiated, forcing the surviving gnomes into exile. Many, including Talvash del Kissel, now live alongside the dwarves in Ironforge.

faq.q: What is this candy used for?
faq.answer: It is one of four festive sweets needed to complete the Hallow's End task for Jesper, a sick orphan boy at the orphanage in Stormwind's Cathedral Square.

faq.q: What other treats are collected alongside it?
faq.answer: Jesper also asks for Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mint, and Darnassus Marzipan, each gathered from the respective Alliance capital cities.

angles.text: Even without a reclaimed city of their own, gnomes take pride in having their own signature confection represented among the great Alliance capitals during Hallow's End.
Gathering this sweet requires traveling between human, dwarven, and gnomish communities, showcasing the close bonds between the Alliance races during seasonal celebrations.
